title: Fireproof Tome
description: Save items from lava and fire !
body:
# Fireproof Tome<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CFe30v5znkk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Fireproof Tome** is a small vanilla+ datapack that adds a rare new enchantment book for protecting valuable items from lava and fire.

![fireproof](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/968671ce40a00bb6bda281734da71b03ea54c9aa.png)

The tome can only be found in **Bastion Remnant chests** and cannot be crafted or traded from villagers. Use it in an anvil to apply **Fireproof** to valuable items such as shulker boxes, tools, weapons, armor, elytra, and rare loot.

Once enchanted, protected dropped items will survive fire and lava, making it much safer to carry important resources during dangerous adventures.

## Features

- Adds a rare **Fireproof Tome**
- Found only in **Bastion Remnants**
- Cannot be crafted
- Cannot be obtained from villagers
- Applied through an anvil like a normal enchanted book
- Works on valuable items and shulker boxes
- Helps protect your loot from lava and fire
- Balanced as a rare one-use upgrade

## Why?

Losing a shulker box full of valuable items to lava can destroy hours of progress.  
This datapack adds a simple, vanilla-friendly way to protect your most important items — but only if you are willing to explore Bastions and earn it.
